Messages.Author: Killiam
Messages.Body:
Imagine you control Goth Band (GB) and have just played a Leadership Vacuum (LV), placing one counter on it for having dunked a Bishop (so X=1 for LV). You immediately take an action with GB to remove a counter from another Methuselah's master card and add it to the LV. So now there are two counters on LV, but does that mean that X=2 now? More to the point -->
QUESTION: Now that there is a second counter on Leadership Vacuum (played at X=1), how much pool will my prey burn from LV during their unlock phase?

The reason I think the answer might be 1 rather than 2 is that the card says to burn X pool, rather than saying to burn pool equal to the number of counters on the card. Moreover, the card does not say to adjust the value of X according to the number of counters; it merely says that X is the starting number of counters. Still, it would be cool if the combo worked.

Card text pasted below.

Thanks!
-Bill / Killiam

Leadership Vacuum
Master: out-of-turn. Unique.
Only usable when a ready titled vampire controlled by another Methuselah is burned or sent to torpor. Usable during your turn. Put this card in play and put X counters on this card where X is the number of votes that vampire has. That Methuselah burns X pool during each of his or her unlock phases. During his or her unlock phase, if he or she controls a ready vampire with a capacity of 8 or more or with a title, burn this card.

Goth Band
Cost: 2 pool
Unique mortal with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
As a +1 stealth Ⓓ action, the Goth Band may move one counter from any master card controlled by another Methuselah to a master card you control that uses counters. The counter is changed to a counter of the type appropriate to the new card.

-Killiam

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body: Good question, and good point. I would say that still, X has to be 2, otherwise why the counters at all?

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body: I disagree, the text is explicit about what the value of X is ("X is the number of votes that vampire has") and has nothing to do with the counters on the card.

Messages.Author: KoRneeshon
Messages.Body:
Poor wording. Should be:

"That Methuselah burns pool equal to the number of counters on this card during each of his or her unlock phases".

With the current text, I agree with inm8.
